meta.purpose: Adversarial simulation protocols to stress-test VA claims before submission
meta.philosophy: Find weaknesses before the VA does

simulation_output.rationale: The medical opinion uses speculative language ('could be', 'possibly') instead of meeting the VA's evidentiary standard of 'at least as likely as not' (>50% probability).
simulation_output.fix_action: Request provider to amend statement to use probability-based language: 'It is at least as likely as not that...' or 'More likely than not...'
interrogation_questions: Dr. X says it 'might' be related. Why is there no definitive medical link?
Are there other non-service causes for this condition that are equally or more likely?
If the doctor is uncertain, how can the VA be certain?

simulation_output.rationale: Claimant lists symptoms (pain, soreness) but has not provided evidence of a current medical diagnosis. The VA cannot rate symptoms alone; they require a diagnosed condition.
simulation_output.fix_action: Obtain formal diagnosis from healthcare provider. Upload current problem list or diagnostic report.
interrogation_questions: What is the specific medical diagnosis (ICD-10 code)?
How do we know this isn't just normal aging or pre-existing condition?
Where is the diagnostic evidence from a qualified medical professional?

simulation_output.rationale: Claimant states condition began after discharge. Without evidence of in-service incurrence or a nexus linking post-service onset to in-service events, service connection cannot be established.
simulation_output.fix_action: Obtain nexus statement from provider linking current condition to in-service events. OR search service medical records for documented symptoms/treatment during service.
interrogation_questions: If this started after service, how is it service-connected?
Where is the evidence of in-service treatment or diagnosis?
What specific in-service event caused this condition?

simulation_output.lethalWeakness: Stressor Does Not Meet Criterion A
simulation_output.rationale: For PTSD diagnosis, the stressor must meet DSM-5 Criterion A (exposure to actual or threatened death, serious injury, or sexual violence). 'Stressful' work environments or general military hardships do not qualify.
simulation_output.fix_action: Identify specific Criterion A stressor events. If none exist, consider alternative diagnoses (Adjustment Disorder, Anxiety Disorder).
interrogation_questions: What specific life-threatening event occurred?
How does 'stressful work' meet the DSM-5 definition of trauma?
Did the psychologist verify this meets Criterion A requirements?

simulation_output.rationale: Claimant argues Condition B is secondary to Condition A, but Condition A is not service-connected. Secondary conditions require an established, rated primary condition.
simulation_output.fix_action: First establish service connection for the primary condition. Then file for secondary condition.
interrogation_questions: What is the VA rating decision number for the primary condition?
If the primary condition isn't service-connected, how can the secondary be?
Why should we grant a secondary claim when the foundation doesn't exist?

simulation_output.rationale: Claimant argues service permanently aggravated a pre-existing condition, but has not provided evidence of the condition's severity BEFORE service. Without a baseline, we cannot determine if permanent aggravation occurred.
simulation_output.fix_action: Obtain pre-service medical records or entrance examination documentation showing baseline condition. Provide current medical opinion comparing pre-service vs. post-service severity.
interrogation_questions: What evidence shows this condition existed before service?
How severe was it before service compared to now?
How do we know service caused permanent worsening vs. natural progression?

simulation_output.lethalWeakness: Large Time Gap Without Continuity of Symptomatology
simulation_output.rationale: Condition manifested or was diagnosed 20+ years after discharge with no evidence of continuous symptoms or treatment. The VA presumes conditions manifest within one year of discharge unless chronic.
simulation_output.fix_action: Provide evidence of continuous symptoms since discharge (buddy statements, old medical records, employment history showing limitations). OR establish a strong nexus explaining the latency period (e.g., asbestos exposure).
interrogation_questions: If this was service-connected, why did it take 20 years to manifest?
Where is the evidence of symptoms in the years following discharge?
What medical explanation justifies this extreme latency?

simulation_output.lethalWeakness: Service Not in PACT Act Covered Location
simulation_output.rationale: Claimant argues condition is presumptive under PACT Act, but service records do not show deployment to covered locations (Southwest Asia, Afghanistan, etc.). Presumption does not apply.
simulation_output.fix_action: Verify deployment locations in DD-214 Box 13 (Campaign Medals) or obtain deployment orders. If not in covered location, pursue direct service connection instead.
interrogation_questions: Where exactly did you serve? Which base?
What evidence proves exposure in a PACT Act location?
If you weren't in a covered location, why should presumption apply?

simulation_output.lethalWeakness: Range of Motion Not Objectively Measured
simulation_output.rationale: Claimant reports limited ROM but DBQ lacks goniometer measurements in degrees. VA will default to lowest possible rating or request additional examination.
simulation_output.fix_action: Ensure DBQ includes specific ROM measurements in degrees using goniometer. Compare to 38 CFR rating schedule thresholds.
interrogation_questions: What is the exact flexion measurement in degrees?
Was a goniometer used or is this subjective observation?
Without objective data, how can we rate higher than 10%?

simulation_output.rationale: Claimant argues total unemployability but is currently working. Work above the poverty threshold is considered 'substantially gainful' and disqualifies from TDIU.
simulation_output.fix_action: If employment is marginal (below SGA threshold ~$13,000/year), document earnings. If employment ended, provide termination documentation and explanation of disability-related job loss.
interrogation_questions: If you can work part-time, why can't you work full-time?
What is your annual income from this employment?
How do we justify 'total' unemployability when you're currently employed?

COMBAT_VERIFICATION_PRESENT.description: Combat veteran with verified stressor (DD-214 awards)
COMBAT_VERIFICATION_PRESENT.note: 38 USC 1154(b) provides 'benefit of the doubt' for combat veterans

BUDDY_STATEMENTS_PRESENT.description: Lay witness statements from fellow service members
BUDDY_STATEMENTS_PRESENT.note: Corroborates veteran's account of in-service events

PRIVATE_DBQ_COMPLETE.description: Private DBQ submitted (not relying on VA examination)
PRIVATE_DBQ_COMPLETE.note: Controls narrative; reduces risk of hostile VA examiner

PRESUMPTIVE_CONDITION.description: Condition qualifies for presumptive service connection
PRESUMPTIVE_CONDITION.note: No nexus required; only diagnosis needed

NO_MEDICAL_RECORDS.description: No STRs or current treatment records provided

WILLFUL_MISCONDUCT.description: Condition potentially related to willful misconduct (drugs/alcohol)
WILLFUL_MISCONDUCT.note: 38 CFR 3.301 bars benefits for willful misconduct
